            --h3-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.95vw, 0.8rem);
            --stat-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem);

            --slide-padding: clamp(1.2rem, 3.5vw, 3.5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
            --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT FITTING: MANDATORY BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
                --stat-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
                --stat-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
                --stat-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-amber);
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            z-index: 9998;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.5vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.5vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-amber);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        .nav-dot:hover {
            background: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.12s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.19s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.26s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.33s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.40s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.47s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.54s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(9) { transition-delay: 0.61s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(10) { transition-delay: 0.68s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-left {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE-SPECIFIC STYLES
           =========================================== */

        /* --- Title Slide --- */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(232, 168, 56, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(46, 196, 182, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, #0f1419 0%, #141e2b 50%, #0f1419 100%);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
            max-width: min(85vw, 900px);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .title-slide .subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--subtitle-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
            max-width: min(70vw, 700px);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .title-slide .source-tag {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .title-slide .source-tag span {
            color: var(--accent-amber);
        }

        .accent-line {
            width: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-amber);
            margin: 0 auto var(--content-gap);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* --- Content Slides --- */
        .content-slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .slide-header {
            padding: var(--slide-padding) var(--slide-padding) 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .slide-header h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.2;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: min(85vw, 950px);
        }

        .slide-header .slide-subtitle {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: var(--element-gap);
            max-width: min(80vw, 800px);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .slide-body {
            flex: 1;
            padding: var(--content-gap) var(--slide-padding) var(--slide-padding);
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        /* --- Chart Styles --- */
        .chart-container {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        /* Area/Line Chart */
        .area-chart {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: clamp(1px, 0.3vw, 3px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem) 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .area-bar {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
            position: relative;
            transition: all 0.4s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .area-bar .bar-label {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: calc(-1 * clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem));
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .annotation {
            position: absolute;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            font-weight: 600;
            white-space: nowrap;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .annotation::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: calc(-1 * clamp(3px, 0.3vw, 6px));
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 1px;
            height: clamp(3px, 0.3vw, 6px);
            background: var(--accent-amber);
        }

        /* Horizontal Bar Chart */
        .hbar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 6px);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .hbar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 10px);
        }

        .hbar-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            min-width: clamp(55px, 8vw, 90px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .hbar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(14px, 2vw, 24px);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .hbar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            transition: width 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo);
            position: relative;
        }

        .hbar-value {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
            min-width: clamp(30px, 4vw, 50px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* Stat Cards */
        .stat-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-amber);
            flex: 1;
            min-width: clamp(100px, 15vw, 160px);
            max-width: clamp(180px, 22vw, 220px);
        }

        .stat-card .stat-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--stat-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            line-height: 1.1;
        }

        .stat-card .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .stat-card.teal { border-left-color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .stat-card.teal .stat-value { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .stat-card.coral { border-left-color: var(--accent-coral); }
        .stat-card.coral .stat-value { color: var(--accent-coral); }
        .stat-card.blue { border-left-color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .stat-card.blue .stat-value { color: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* Treemap-style blocks */
        .treemap-grid {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: clamp(3px, 0.4vw, 6px);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            align-content: flex-start;
        }

        .treemap-block {
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .treemap-block .tm-name {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .treemap-block .tm-value {
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* Diverging bar chart */
        .diverging-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 5px);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .div-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 8px);
        }

        .div-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            min-width: clamp(70px, 10vw, 120px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .div-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(12px, 1.6vw, 20px);
            position: relative;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .div-center-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 1px;
            background: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .div-bar {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            transition: all 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .div-bar.decline {
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            right: 50%;
        }

        .div-bar.growth {
            background: var(--accent-coral);
            left: 50%;
        }

        .div-value {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.7vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(28px, 3vw, 40px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* Comparison blocks */
        .comparison-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            align-content: center;
        }

        .comparison-col {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .comparison-col h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .comparison-col .comp-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }

        .comparison-col .comp-item .comp-val {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
        }

        /* Takeaway bullets */
        .takeaway-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            flex: 1;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 6px;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-amber);
        }

        .takeaway-item .tk-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .takeaway-item .tk-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .takeaway-item .tk-text strong {
            color: var(--accent-amber);
        }

        /* Footnote / source line */
        .slide-footnote {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.7vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* Background patterns */
        .bg-grid {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 40px 40px;
        }

        .bg-glow-warm {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 90%, rgba(232, 168, 56, 0.06) 0%, transparent 40%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .bg-glow-teal {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 10%, rgba(46, 196, 182, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        /* Slide number indicator */
        .slide-num {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        /* Inline highlight */
        .hl-amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .hl-teal { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .hl-coral { color: var(--accent-coral); }
        .hl-blue { color: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* Chart axis label */
        .axis-label {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.7vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <!-- Progress bar -->

         SLIDE 1: TITLE

    <section class="slide title-slide bg-grid" data-slide="0">

                Fossil fuels & industry · 1750–2024
            </p>

         ========================================== -->
    <section class="slide content-slide bg-glow-warm bg-grid" data-slide="1">
        <div class="slide-header">
            <h2 class="reveal">Global CO<sub>2</sub> Emissions Grew from <span class="hl-amber">6 Bt</span> in 1950 to Over <span class="hl-amber">35 Bt</span> Today</h2>
            <p class="slide-subtitle reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.1s;">Fossil fuel and industry emissions, 1750–2024. Growth has slowed but no peak yet.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="slide-body">
            <div class="chart-container reveal-scale" style="transition-delay: 0.2s;">
                <div class="axis-label" style="margin-bottom: 2px;">Billion tonnes CO<sub>2</sub>/year</div>
                <div class="area-chart" id="growthChart" style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">
                    <!-- Y-axis reference lines rendered via JS -->
                </div>
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 2px;">
                    <span class="axis-label">1750</span>
                    <span class="axis-label">1850</span>
                    <span class="axis-label">1950</span>
                    <span class="axis-label">1990</span>
                    <span class="axis-label">2024</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-row reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.35s; margin-top: var(--element-gap);">
                <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">~0</div><div class="stat-label">1750 emissions</div></div>
                <div class="stat-card amber"><div class="stat-value">6 Bt</div><div class="stat-label">1950</div></div>
                <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">20 Bt</div><div class="stat-label">1990</div></div>

            </div>

        <div class="slide-footnote">Source: Global Carbon Budget 2025 via Our World in Data</div>
        <div class="slide-num">02 / 09</div>
    </section>

    <!-- ==========================================
         SLIDE 3: REGIONAL SHARE SHIFT
         ========================================== -->

    <!-- ==========================================
       JAVASCRIPT: Slide Controller + Chart Rendering
       ========================================== -->
    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           AREA CHART DATA (Slide 2)
           Global CO2 emissions trajectory 1750-2024
           =========================================== */
        function renderGrowthChart() {
            const chart = document.getElementById('growthChart');
            if (!chart) return;

            /* Approximate data points for global CO2 (Bt) */
            const data = [
                { year: 1750, val: 0.003 },
                { year: 1800, val: 0.05 },
                { year: 1850, val: 0.2 },
                { year: 1900, val: 2.0 },
                { year: 1920, val: 3.0 },
                { year: 1940, val: 4.5 },
                { year: 1950, val: 6.0 },
                { year: 1960, val: 9.5 },
                { year: 1970, val: 14.5 },
                { year: 1980, val: 19.5 },
                { year: 1990, val: 20.5 },
                { year: 2000, val: 23.5 },
                { year: 2010, val: 30.0 },
                { year: 2015, val: 32.0 },
                { year: 2020, val: 33.5 },
                { year: 2024, val: 36.0 },
            ];

            const maxVal = 38;
            const chartHeight = chart.clientHeight || 300;

            data.forEach((d, i) => {
                const pct = (d.val / maxVal) * 100;
                const bar = document.createElement('div');
                bar.className = 'area-bar';
                bar.style.height = pct + '%';

                /* Gradient from teal (low) to amber (high) */
                const ratio = d.val / maxVal;
                if (ratio < 0.3) {
                    bar.style.background = 'var(--accent-teal)';
                } else if (ratio < 0.6) {
                    bar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent-teal), var(--accent-amber))';
                } else {
                    bar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent-amber), var(--accent-coral))';
                }

                /* Annotations for key inflection points */
                if (d.year === 1950) {
                    const ann = document.createElement('span');
                    ann.className = 'annotation';
                    ann.textContent = 'Post-war acceleration';
                    ann.style.top = '-18px';
                    ann.style.left = '50%';
                    ann.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
                    bar.appendChild(ann);
                }
                if (d.year === 2024) {
                    const ann = document.createElement('span');
                    ann.className = 'annotation';
                    ann.textContent = '35+ Bt — no peak yet';
                    ann.style.top = '-18px';
                    ann.style.left = '50%';
                    ann.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
                    bar.appendChild(ann);
                }

                chart.appendChild(bar);
            });

            /* Y-axis reference lines */
            [10, 20, 30].forEach(v => {
                const line = document.createElement('div');
                line.style.position = 'absolute';
                line.style.left = '0';
                line.style.right = '0';
                line.style.bottom = (v / maxVal * 100) + '%';
                line.style.height = '1px';
                line.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
                line.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

                const label = document.createElement('span');
                label.style.position = 'absolute';
                label.style.right = 'calc(100% + 4px)';
                label.style.top = '-6px';
                label.style.fontSize = 'clamp(0.45rem, 0.6vw, 0.55rem)';
                label.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
                label.textContent = v;
                line.appendChild(label);

                chart.appendChild(line);
            });
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = parseInt(entry.target.dataset.slide);
                            if (!isNaN(idx)) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'PageDown' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!container) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.dots = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.dots) return;
                this.dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = idx;
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           INIT
           =========================================== */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            renderGrowthChart();
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

3	
4	Strategy: use Playwright to simulate keyboard navigation (ArrowRight) through
5	the presentation, taking a full-viewport screenshot of each slide, then
6	assemble the images into a 16:9 PPTX via python-pptx.
7	
8	A local HTTP server is started so Google Fonts and relative asset paths load
9	correctly (file:// protocol blocks cross-origin font requests).
10	
11	Usage:
12	    python html_to_pptx.py <input.html> <output.pptx> [--width 1920] [--height 1080]
13	"""
14

16	import os
17	import http.server
18	import subprocess
19	import sys
20	import tempfile
21	import threading
22	from pathlib import Path
23	
24	from PIL import Image
25	from pptx import Presentation
26	from pptx.util import Emu
27	
28	
29	# CSS selectors to count slides, tried in order
30	SLIDE_SELECTORS = [".slide", "[data-slide]", "section", "div > section"]
31	
32	
33	def _make_screenshot_script(url: str, out_dir: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
34	    """Return a Node.js script that navigates and screenshots each slide."""
35	    selectors_js = ", ".join(f'"{s}"' for s in SLIDE_SELECTORS)
36	    return f"""\
37	const {{ chromium }} = require('playwright');
38	
39	(async () => {{
40	    const browser = await chromium.launch({{ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH || undefined }});
41	    const page = await browser.newPage();
42	    await page.setViewportSize({{ width: {width}, height: {height} }});
43	    await page.goto('{url}', {{ waitUntil: 'networkidle' }});
44	
45	    // --- Count slides using DOM selectors ---
46	    const selectors = [{selectors_js}];
47	    let slideCount = 0;
48	    for (const sel of selectors) {{
49	        slideCount = await page.$$eval(sel, els => els.length);
50	        if (slideCount > 0) break;
51	    }}
52	
53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---
65	    // We track visual changes to detect when navigation has no more effect
66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).
67	    let prevPath = `{out_dir}/slide_001.png`;
68	    let captured = 1;
69	
70	    for (let i = 2; i <= slideCount; i++) {{
71	        await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
72	        // Wait for transition animation to complete
73	        await page.waitForTimeout(600);
74	
75	        const idx = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
76	        const path = `{out_dir}/slide_${{idx}}.png`;
77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});
78	        captured++;
79	    }}
80	
81	    console.log(JSON.stringify({{ captured }}));
82	    await browser.close();
83	}})();
84	"""

86	
87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique
